description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryDecorator class, which provides methods to decorate or manipulate EmployeeSalary entities by associating related entities such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType through reference lookups. It serves as a helper or decorator pattern implementation for managing employee salary data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeSalary entities, enabling setting related entities through reference IDs and providing encapsulation of EmployeeSalary manipulation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSalary entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped EmployeeSalary entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on EmployeeSalary using an employee number.

methods.name: setPayPeriodById
methods.description: Sets the PayPeriod entity on EmployeeSalary using an ID, or null if ID is null.

methods.name: setPayGradeById
methods.description: Sets the PayGrade entity on EmployeeSalary using an ID, or null if ID is null.

methods.name: setCurrencyTypeById
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType entity on EmployeeSalary using a string ID.
